finding: Backfill Runner run 36351266066 (2026-09-27, repoint-sales-by-list REPORT against scope data/sales-repoints/2026-09-27-baseball-unsigned-twins-r0927d.json, the R-0927d unsigned-twin sales repoint for #2453) refused 1,869 of the lists 3,265 entries as REFUSED (zero-sales): the :no-auto fromId carries no sold_comps rows at all, so there is nothing for that lane to move. Each refused fromId is a checklist-grade card_catalog row minted unsigned by the checklistinsider-layout-mints-autos-unsigned defect (R-0927d, #2453) at a cardNumber prefix already registered autograph-only; its :auto twin is the checklist-grade row for that (cardNumber, parallel, printRun) and is never touched by this list. Because the fromId has zero sales, retiring it moves nothing into the unplaced/rematch pool -- the row is empty and simply extra. This list is step 2 of R-0927d (the sales-repoint list is step 1, already run as the REPORT this list cites); relocate-catalog-rows-by-list re-checks sales at delete time via its own salesAt(id) DUAL gate (both the cross-partition and the partition-scoped read must show zero) before any row is removed, so a row that picked up a sale between the 09-27 REPORT and this APPLY is refused at delete time rather than deleted.
rulings: THE LIST NAMES CANDIDATES, THE LANE RE-CHECKS AT DELETE TIME. relocate-catalog-rows-by-list.cjs gates every retire on salesAt(id) === 0 for the fromId shape, read fresh at run time (both the cross-partition and the partition-scoped form via the DUAL check) -- this list does not carry a point-in-time salesAtRetireTime snapshot the way the TCUS spelling-dupes retire list does, because the source measurement here is the 09-27 REPORT run itself (zero rows moved onto or off any of these ids in the ndjson plan), not a separate census script.

WHY THESE ARE SAFE TO DELETE AND NOT JUST UNMATCHED. Each id is a :no-auto row at a cardNumber prefix R-0927d and #2453 already established is autograph-only (global AUTO_ONLY_CARDNUMBER_PREFIX or a per-product SCOPED_AUTO_ONLY_PREFIXES entry) with a checklist-grade :auto twin present at the same (cardNumber, parallel, printRun). The :no-auto row is not a different card that happens to have no sales -- it is the checklistinsider layout defect minting an unsigned address for a card that is only ever sold signed. Retiring it removes a row that can never legitimately hold a sale, not a row that might yet.

SS- (2025 panini-prizm) STAYS EXCLUDED, as it was in the sales-repoint list: #2453 found all 1,409 SS- pairs DERIVED on both sides, never checklist-grade, so R-0927d does not reach panini-prizm and none of its ids appear here.
